title: One source item as fc_train_final.json actually holds it
description: The shape all 21,172 records are in today: no `tools` key, and the catalog rendered into the system message after a `TOOLS:` line. Declared so ingest can assert what it is reading before converting it, rather than discovering the difference through a parse that silently returns less.

content.description:
The instruction, then "

$comment: Every record in the file has exactly three turns in this order, and every system message contains the TOOLS: line -- both measured over all 21,172, not assumed.
